description:
Diagnosis: audit of the 8 agent-loop tool implementations in domain/agents/_internal/agents.py found real correctness bugs (same class as the file_search --max-count=0 zero-results bug, already fixed on main):

1. _execute_subprocess uses bare python3 from PATH, not sys.executable — code runs outside the sloughgpt env (missing deps/wrong interpreter). asyncio.wait_for timeout cancels communicate() but never kills the child — orphaned processes survive timeouts.
2. _search_web: no follow_redirects (DDG POST 302s to empty), no raise_for_status (403 bot pages => silent success:0), results carry no url (citations impossible).
3. file_read / file_search(path) / data_analysis / image_analysis accept arbitrary model-supplied paths with zero restriction (SecurityConfig.allowed_directories exists but is never read; ~/.ssh/.env readable). Sensitive-dir + .env blocklist, honor allowlist when configured.
4. data_analysis: jsonl truncated at 500KB mid-line => whole tool errors; no truncation flag on CSV/JSON counts (silent wrong totals).
5. knowledge fallback: full-substring query match => near-zero recall, silent empty.
6. image_analysis: ImportError/vision errors return success:True (masks failure).
7. test_real_grep asserts only isinstance(list) — would never catch a zero-results bug.

Plan: branch fix/agent-tools-correctness; fixes + tests in tests/core-py/test_agent_core.py; gates = ruff check/format + 61+ core-py agent tests + server agent router tests; merge to main when green; AGENT_SYNC entry; benchmark n/a (tool plumbing, not model perf).
title: agent tools correctness: fix silent failures, code env, path guard

description:
Diagnosis: PRODUCT_ENGINEERING prescriptions are documentation-only — nothing mechanical runs them.
- Client/core separation + CCGT rule have no gate (Page Rule precedent: documentation alone did not hold the line).
- domain/ has 39 top-level dirs, no catalogue, no ratchet: domain/journeys is a UX_FLOWS projection/runner (belongs outside domain/), domain/mobile is a server push-notification service wearing a client name, cognition+cognitive duplicate pair, api/ops/infrastructure overlap.
- Contrast: pages have page-baseline.json + page-journey-gate.test.ts; routers have _manifest.py. Folders have nothing.

Plan (mirror the Page Rule mechanism exactly):
1. domain-baseline.json: catalogue every domain/*/ with {class: core-capability|feature|projection|misfiled, cCGT facets [cognitive|core|gateway|training], consumers, note}.
2. Gate test (tests/core-py/test_domain_baseline.py): every domain/*/ on disk must be catalogued; NEW entries must not be class:misfiled; counts of misfiled/grandfathered may only shrink (ratchet like page-baseline).
3. First shrinks: move domain/journeys out (projection -> scripts/ or tests layer; update python -m domain.journeys entry + tests/test_ux_flows_library), rename/absorb domain/mobile -> feature name (notifications) with compat re-export.
4. Gate must pass on main before/after moves (grandfathered entries allow current misfiled until shrunk).

Must NOT touch: legitimate domain/* capability folders; multimodal consumers; apps/mobile client.
Verification: PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PYTHONPATH=... pytest tests/core-py/test_domain_baseline.py -q (green on main pre- and post-change; misfiled count strictly non-increasing).
Priority: supersedes the agent image-facade card (that one rides after).
title: domain-baseline gate: mechanical ratchet for domain/ layout (CCGT + client/core separation)

description:
Always-sync kanban+notes to GitHub. CI cannot see ~/.config (canonical store) — split producer/verifier:

PRODUCER (local): scripts/kanban_sync.sh — flock-serialized, ONE detached worktree (/home/mana/.cache/kanban-sync-wt pinned to origin/main; jolly-wizard holds main so a second main checkout is impossible — detached sidesteps it AND isolates every session tree). Loop x3: fetch+reset -> app-planner export -> commit -> push HEAD:main; rejection = re-export fresh + retry (push races known here). systemd user timer kanban-sync.timer every 5min Persistent=true (covers no-commit periods; single writer avoids the 2026-10-27 149-commit fork incident).

EXPORT (app-planner): new app_planner export + CLI subcommand — mirror canonical board -> <repo>/.kanban/board.jsonl (the live file check_board_chain verifies, NOT the dated snapshots dir), mirror notes -> <repo>/dev-notes (byte-exact add/update/remove; git-tracked so recoverable; canonical is source of truth per config doctrine), write .kanban/manifest.json {exported_at, note_count, card_count, board_sha256}. snapshot subcommand unchanged (manual dated history).

VERIFIER (GitHub): scripts/check_kanban_freshness.py (stdlib) — fail if manifest.exported_at older than 120min; wired into ci.yml verify-kanban job right after check_board_chain. Alarm meaning: producer died.

UNITS: versioned in repo infra/systemd-user/kanban-sync.{service,timer}, installed to ~/.config/systemd/user/.

GATES: app-planner test suite (new export tests incl. stale-note removal + manifest counts), bash -n script, ruff, live first run -> manifest on main -> CI green.
NOTE: notes mirror DELETES repo .dev-notes files absent from canonical (git-tracked, history keeps them) — first run may prune legacy orphans; recorded in commit message.
title: kanban sync pipeline: local producer timer + app-planner export + CI freshness alarm
